CHAPTER 1 · LISTENING 2

Freshman Workshop – You're On Your Own!

Grade 10 General · Ms. Saidah Khwar · Pages 9–11 ·

OBJECTIVES

Students will be able to understand key vocabulary and identify main ideas and specific details in a college time-management talk.

SUCCESS CRITERIA

I can use the target vocabulary, identify Terry Sargent’s three tips, and explain useful time-management advice.

KEY WORDS

deadline · cross it off · schedule · on my own · tip · tutor · manage

45-MINUTE FLOW

Starter · Brainstorm5 min Main 1 · Vocabulary + Audio7 min Main 2 · Fill in the Gaps8 min Main 3 · Listening for Main Ideas & Details18 min Exit Ticket · Study Habits Challenge7 min
CHARTER CONNECTION · LIFELONG LEARNING

Independence means managing yourself.

Think — 1 min: Which one of Terry’s three tips would improve your school life most?

Discuss — 2 min: Compare your choice with a partner and give one reason.

Write: “This week I will ______ because ______.”

Share: One practical commitment with the class.
